open.description: The controlled open state of the hover card

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the hover card when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the hover card.

open-delay.description: The duration from when the mouse enters the trigger until the hover card opens.

close-delay.description: The duration from when the mouse leaves the trigger or content until the hover card closes.

disabled.description: Whether the hover card is disabled

default-trigger-value.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the hover card opens or closes.

triggervaluechange.description: Fired when the trigger value changes.

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

positioning.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content
